Each player's position in each match (the match_ level)

Source: R/positions.R
position_match.Rd

One row per lineup row, with the position he played in that match in every grouping and where it came from:

Usage

position_match(lineups, events, slot_table = NULL)

Arguments

lineups

Lineup rows with match_id, team_id, player_id, position, position_side, is_starter, minutes_played.

events

Opta events with match_id, team_id, player_id, type_id, period_id, minute, qualifier_json (only types 34 and 40 are used).

slot_table

A position_slot_table() result, or NULL to build one from lineups and events. Pass a fixed table when scoring a small subset of matches.

Value

A data.table with match_id, team_id, player_id, match_is_starter, match_formation, match_slot, match_slot_role_full, match_role_full, match_role16, match_role8, match_role4, match_role_source, in the row order of lineups.

Details

  • opta: a starter with an Opta position and side.

  • opta_sub: a substitute, from the position Opta records on his sub-on event (qualifiers 292 and 293; on 96-100% of sub-ons from 2015). Measured 2026-10-19 on 101,484 subs, this matches where he touched the ball as often as his usual position does (39.3% vs 39.6%) and more often than his slot (31.8%): the slot is the departing player's.

  • slot: a substitute with no Opta sub position, or a starter with a blank label, who took a slot whose kick-off holder in this match had a label, with the formation unchanged since kick-off. He gets that holder's position. Opta records the slot on every sub-on event (qualifier 145).

  • slot_table: the formation had changed, or the slot's holder had no label, so the position is the most common one for that formation and slot (position_slot_table()).

  • none: he played but no slot is known (no event data for the match). Every role column is NA; fill from the asof_ level where a value is needed.

  • unused: an unused substitute. Every role column is NA.

In a back three with no full-back slot (3-4-3, 3-5-2, ...), a wide midfielder (LM / RM) is recorded as a wing-back (LWB / RWB), so role8 groups him with full-backs: that is where he touches the ball.

A player moved by a later formation change keeps the position he started the match (or came on) in. match_slot_role_full keeps the position the slot implies (for a sub, the departing player's), whatever the source.

See also

Other positions: position_asof(), position_career(), position_roles(), position_season(), position_slot_table()
